The problem

Life admin doesn't wait for a good time.

It shows up in three places at once — your inbox, your bills, your calendar — and none of them talk to each other.

Somewhere in there is something that matters.

Important messages get buried under everything else, and there's never a good time to dig them back out.

Due dates don't send a second reminder.

A late fee usually isn't about not caring — it's about nobody watching until it's already too late.

Meetings collide when no one's looking.

Without a second set of eyes, conflicts only show up once they're already a problem for someone.

How it works

Three quiet steps. No new habits to build.

Handled works in the background — not another app you have to remember to open.

1

Connect your accounts

Securely link your inbox, bills, and calendar. Takes about two minutes, once.

2

Handled triages and tracks

It reads, sorts, and quietly keeps watch — flagging what matters and tracking what's due.

3

You get a daily summary, not chaos

One calm digest each morning, and a gentle nudge only when something actually needs you.
